CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListSort

Returns a list with its elements sorted alphabetically or numerically, in ascending or descending order.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListSort(list, sort_type [, sort_order ] [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to sort.
sort_type
numeric sorts numbers, text sorts strings with upper case before lower case, textnocase sorts strings without regard to case.
sort_order
Optional. asc (the default) or desc.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma. The first character separates the elements of the result.

Returns

The sorted list.

Usage

A numeric sort of a list that contains something other than numbers causes an error, as does an unknown sort type. Empty elements are dropped. To sort a query, use ORDER BY in CFQUERY; to sort an array, ArraySort.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Fruit = "banana,Cherry,apple,date,Elderberry">
<CFSET Scores = "100,9,42,1999,7">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Expression</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>ListSort(Fruit, "text")</TD><TD>#ListSort(Fruit, "text")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListSort(Fruit, "textnocase")</TD><TD>#ListSort(Fruit, "textnocase")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListSort(Fruit, "textnocase", "desc")</TD><TD>#ListSort(Fruit, "textnocase", "desc")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListSort(Scores, "numeric")</TD><TD>#ListSort(Scores, "numeric")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListSort(Scores, "text")</TD><TD>#ListSort(Scores, "text")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
